thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 detected: inference-serving errors spiking in us-west-2 (latency + 5xx). Auto-page delivered at 1763000000. Root cause still under investigation but symptoms point to degraded GPU pool and routing fallbacks failing. Logs/timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1763000000 — requesting post-incident review scheduling and runbook updates. Please reply with availability and any immediate remediation items.

sara: ack — I'm oncall and saw the pages. Got the initial mitigation: drained the unhealthy nodes and forced traffic to fallback model variants. Latency recovered ~3m after that but experienced brief customer errors. I’ll own the postmortem and runbook edits unless someone else volunteers.

raj: thanks @sara. Quick notes from the debugging run: fallback routing didn't trigger for ~90s because the routing policy retries RPCs instead of failing fast. Propose we change default retry window and add a fast-path escalation in the incident command playbook.

maria: tagging customer-impact: noticed 12 enterprise requests failed with 502s between 15:22–15:25 PST, likely from tenant redwood-payments. Need comms and an impact timeline for SOC/CS. I'll draft a customer note once we have the timeline.

ellie: I can take the runbook edits. I'll add a new section: "Paging & Escalation - fast fail thresholds" + examples. Putting draft in https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xk-runbook-draft — please comment.

tom: also adding ops steps for immediate mitigation into the playbook: add a "partial capacity fallback" section with explicit commands. Example snippet for K8s drain/run:

```bash
# mark node unschedulable and evict inference pods gracefully
kubectl cordon gpu-host-42
kubectl drain gpu-host-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# scale fallback deployment
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-fallback --replicas=5 -n inference
```

sara: good — actionable list so far: 1) ellie runbook edits due EOD tomorrow (owner: ellie), 2) raj to propose routing retry policy PR by EOW (owner: raj), 3) maria to draft customer comms after timeline (owner: maria), 4) tom to add mitigation commands and verification checklist (owner: tom). I’ll schedule the postmortem meeting for Thursday 10:00am PT and create the postmortem ticket with links.

raj: on the routing change proposal: suggested config (pseudo):

```yaml
# routing-config.yaml snippet
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 1
  fast_fail_threshold_ms: 500
  escalate_on_consecutive_failures: 3
```

This should make the service fail fast and trigger the escalation hook in the incident command flow. Will add tests.

maria: FYI CS lead @julian has been notified. I'll coordinate any VIP outreach after the meeting. Also recommend adding a quick "Customer impact" checkbox in the runbook template so we don't forget to RAG-rate affected tenants.

ellie: made the first pass in the doc and added a "When to page senior" flowchart + a sample runbook excerpt. Also added a template section for postmortem owners/action tracking. Link updated. Please review before EOD.

ops-bot: deploy job #4821 completed (canary->prod) 1763000300 — logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4821 — no obvious correlation to traffic spike per initial check.

sara: scheduling note — postmortem invite sent to incident channel + product + cs. Agenda: timeline, RCA hypotheses, action items, runbook updates. If you cannot make 10am PT, please propose alternate in-thread.

incident-bot: Reminder: use the Postmortem template (https://wiki.redwood/postmortems/template) and tag the incident with severity and customer impact fields. Automations will pull action items into the runbook backlog. :memo:

sara: final call — owners and deadlines locked. I'll update the runbook PR with the changes agreed and tag reviewers after ellie pushes the draft. Thanks all for fast responses. :thumbsup:
